definition.name: Acolyte
definition.description: You have spent your life in the service of a temple to a specific god or pantheon of gods. You act as an intermediary between the realm of the holy and the mortal world, performing sacred rites and offering sacrifices in order to conduct
definition.shortDescription: You have spent your life in the service of a temple to a specific god or pantheon of gods. You act as an intermediary between the realm of the holy and the mortal world, performing sacred rites and offering sacrifices in order to conduct
definition.equipmentDescription: A holy symbol (a gift to you when you entered the priesthood), a prayer book or prayer wheel, 5 sticks of incense, vestments, a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 15 gp.
definition.featureDescription: As an acolyte, you command the respect of those who share your faith, and you can perform the religious ceremonies of your deity. You and your adventuring companions can expect to receive free healing and care at a temple, shrine, or oth
definition.cardDescription: You serve a specific god or pantheon, performing sacred rites and conducting worshipers into the presence of the divine.
definition.suggestedCharacteristicsDescription: Acolytes are shaped by their experience in temples or other religious communities. Their study of the history and tenets of their faith and their relationships to temples, shrines, or hierarchies affect their mannerisms and ideals. Their

personalityTraits.description: I idolize a particular hero of my faith, and constantly refer to that person’s deeds and example.
I can find common ground between the fiercest enemies, empathizing with them and always working toward peace.
I see omens in every event and action. The gods try to speak to us, we just need to listen.
Nothing can shake my optimistic attitude.
I quote (or misquote) sacred texts and proverbs in almost every situation.
I am tolerant (or intolerant) of other faiths and respect (or condemn) the worship of other gods.
I’ve enjoyed fine food, drink, and high society among my temple’s elite. Rough living grates on me.
I’ve spent so long in the temple that I have little practical experience dealing with people in the outside world.

ideals.description: Tradition. The ancient traditions of worship and sacrifice must be preserved and upheld. (Lawful)
Charity. I always try to help those in need, no matter what the personal cost. (Good)
Change. We must help bring about the changes the gods are constantly working in the world. (Chaotic)
Power. I hope to one day rise to the top of my faith’s religious hierarchy. (Lawful)
Faith. I trust that my deity will guide my actions. I have faith that if I work hard, things will go well. (Lawful)
Aspiration. I seek to prove myself worthy of my god’s favor by matching my actions against his or her teachings. (Any)

bonds.description: I would die to recover an ancient relic of my faith that was lost long ago.
I will someday get revenge on the corrupt temple hierarchy who branded me a heretic.
I owe my life to the priest who took me in when my parents died.
Everything I do is for the common people.
I will do anything to protect the temple where I served.
I seek to preserve a sacred text that my enemies consider heretical and seek to destroy.

flaws.description: I judge others harshly, and myself even more severely.
I put too much trust in those who wield power within my temple’s hierarchy.
My piety sometimes leads me to blindly trust those that profess faith in my god.
I am inflexible in my thinking.
I am suspicious of strangers and expect the worst of them.
Once I pick a goal, I become obsessed with it to the detriment of everything else in my life.

race.description:
Halflings possess a brave and adventurous spirit that leads them on journeys of discovery.

Halfling Traits
Brave, Halfling Nimbleness, Luck, Naturally Stealthy
race.longDescription: Cherished and guided by gods who value life, home, and hearth, halflings gravitate toward bucolic havens where family and community help shape their lives. That said, many halflings possess a brave and adventurous spirit that leads them

definition.name: Brave
definition.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.
definition.snippet: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

definition.name: Halfling Nimbleness
definition.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can’t stop in the same space.
definition.snippet: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can’t stop in the same space.

definition.name: Luck
definition.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.
definition.snippet: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

definition.name: Naturally Stealthy
definition.description: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.
definition.snippet: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

definition.name: Creature Type
definition.description: You are Humanoid.
definition.snippet: You are Humanoid.

definition.name: Size
definition.description: Your Size is Small (about 2–3 feet tall).
definition.snippet: Your Size is Small.

definition.name: Speed
definition.description: Your Speed is 30 feet.
definition.snippet: Your Speed is 30 ft.

definition.name: Ability Score Increases
definition.description: When determining your character’s ability scores, increase one score by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase three scores by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.
definition.snippet: When determining your character’s ability scores, increase one score by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase three scores by 1.

definition.name: Languages
definition.description: Your character knows at least three languages: Common plus two languages you roll or choose from the Standard Languages table. Knowledge of a language means your character can communicate in it, read it, and write it. Your class and othe
definition.snippet: Your character knows at least three languages: Common plus two languages you roll or choose from the Standard Languages table. Knowledge of a language means your character can communicate in it, read it, and write it.

race.highlights:
1. Venture forth with a brave, adventurous spirit and a diminutive stature.
  2. Slip past trouble with nimble feet and a gift for stealth.
  3. Turn close calls into triumphs with uncanny halfling luck.

definition.tagline: An Occultist Empowered by Otherworldly Pacts
definition.cardDescription: Warlocks quest for hidden knowledge, entering into pacts with ancient beings to bolster their own power.
definition.highlights:
• Form a pact with a mysterious entity to achieve magical power.
  • Uncover eldritch truths to gain abiding supernatural abilities.
  • Deepen your occult connection with your patron to attain greater power.
definition.iconicGear:
• Leather Armor and a Sickle
  • Occult attire and tomes
  • Rod of the Pact Keeper
definition.subclassFlavorText: At later levels you’ll make a pact with your Patron.

definition.name: Core Warlock Traits
definition.description:
As a Level 1 Character:

  • Gain all the traits in the Core Warlock Traits table.
  • Gain the Warlock’s level 1 features.
definition.multiClassDescription:
As a Multiclass Character:

  • Gain the following traits from the Core Warlock Traits table: Hit Point Die and training with Light armor.
  • Gain the Warlock’s level 1 features. See the multiclassing rules to determine

definition.name: Eldritch Invocations
definition.description: You have unearthed Eldritch Invocations, pieces of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability or other lessons. You gain one invocation of your choice, such as Pact of the Tome. Invocations are described in the &l
definition.snippet: You have unearthed Eldritch Invocations, pieces of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability or other lessons. If an invocation has a prerequisite, you must meet it to learn that invocation.

definition.name: Pact Magic
definition.description:
Through occult ceremony, you have formed a pact with a mysterious entity to gain magical powers. The entity is a voice in the shadows—its identity unclear—but its boon to you is concrete: the ability to cast spells.

Channeling the chill of the grave, make a melee spell attack against a target within reach. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage, and it can’t regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.
